title: Phone won't power off during interview
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Phone won't power off during interview, about 2026 at Interview location, UK, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Let's document all of this. You can see my finger is on the power button

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, interviewed Gary McKinnon in the UK in 2026. McKinnon is a computer hacker who says he found signs of a secret space program in NASA's computers (NASA is the US space agency). Michels says that during the interview his phone would not turn off, and he filmed his finger pressing the power button to prove it, as if something was interfering with the conversation.
